testcase.name: Scenario: Sort recent rows by name and carry the order into Grid View: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:187:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Sort recent rows by name and carry the order into Grid View ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents with different names are displayed in List View ✔ And Last Opened is the active descending sort ✔ When the user selects the Name column header ✔ Then the visible rows are ordered by name in descending order ✔ And a downward sort indicator appears in the Name header ✔ When the user selects the Name column header again ✔ Then the visible rows are ordered by name in ascending order ✔ And the Name header shows an upward sort indicator ✔ When the user switches to Grid View ✔ Then Sort by shows Name with an upward direction indicator ✔ And the visible cards follow the ascending name order
